레위기 19:1.content: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

레위기 19:2.content: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the Lord your God am holy.

레위기 19:3.content: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.

레위기 19:4.content: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the Lord your God.

레위기 19:5.content: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord, ye shall offer it at your own will.

레위기 19:6.content: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.

레위기 19:7.content: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.

레위기 19:8.content: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the Lord: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

레위기 19:9.content: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

레위기 19:10.content: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the Lord your God.

레위기 19:11.content: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

레위기 19:12.content: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.

레위기 19:13.content: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

레위기 19:14.content: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord.

레위기 19:15.content: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

레위기 19:16.content: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the Lord.

레위기 19:17.content: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

레위기 19:18.content: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the Lord.

레위기 19:19.content: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

레위기 19:20.content: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

레위기 19:21.content: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.

레위기 19:22.content: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the Lord for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

레위기 19:23.content: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.

레위기 19:24.content: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the Lord withal.

레위기 19:25.content: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the Lord your God.

레위기 19:26.content: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.

레위기 19:27.content: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

레위기 19:28.content: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the Lord.

레위기 19:29.content: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

레위기 19:30.content: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord.

레위기 19:31.content: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the Lord your God.

레위기 19:32.content: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the Lord.

레위기 19:33.content: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.

레위기 19:34.content: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

레위기 19:35.content: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

레위기 19:36.content: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.

레위기 19:37.content: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the Lord.
